title: Truncated alteration descent with unchanged normal-crossing branches
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$. Let $h:X'\to X$ be a local morphism of Noetherian strictly henselian local schemes with closed points $x',x$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Assume $\ell$ is invertible on $X$. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open and put $U'=X'\times_XU$ [def-weil-open-immersion, def-pc-fibre-product]. Fix $L\geq1$. Let $X_\bullet\to X$ be a hypercover for the topology of $\ell'$-alterations [def-per-prime-to-ell-alteration-topology]: an augmented simplicial diagram whose maps to matching objects are covers, with matching objects and pullback formed using the reduced union of components dominating a component of the base. Let $X'_\bullet\to X'$ be its pullback in this sense, and assume that $X'_\bullet\to X'$ is again a hypercover for the topology of $\ell'$-alterations (this is not automatic for an arbitrary local $h$). It suffices to give these diagrams through degree $L$. Put $U_a=X_a\times_XU$ and $U'_a=X'_a\times_{X'}U'$, with reduced induced closed complements. Suppose for every $0\leq a\leq L$ and geometric point $z'$ of $(X'_a)_{x'}$ with image $z$ in $(X_a)_x$ that both strict localizations $(X_a)_{(z)}$ and $(X'_a)_{(z')}$ are regular; the complement of $U_a$ in the first is a strict normal crossings divisor with branch equations $f_1,\ldots,f_r$; and the pulled-back equations define the complement of $U'_a$ and have linearly independent classes in $\mathfrak m_{z'}/\mathfrak m_{z'}^2$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit, def-weil-regular-scheme, def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Empty boundaries are allowed ($r=0$). Then canonical pullback is an isomorphism
$$H^q(U,\underline{\mathbf F_\ell})\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(U',\underline{\mathbf F_\ell})\qquad(0\leq q<L),$$
for ordinary small-etale cohomology of constant abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].

source.place: Expose XV, Propositions 2.1.7, 2.2.2 and 2.2.4, printed pp.221–222, truncated form N=L-1. The prime-to-ell topology is contained in the unrestricted alteration topology there; the parameter condition is 2.1.4.
